description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to procure Splunk Enterprise Security term licenses (2,500 GB/day ingest) and 12 months of vendor support on a brand name only basis.

The Contractor shall provide licenses that integrate with the existing Splunk Enterprise deployment at the VA Network Security Operations Center. No other product will be considered.

Offerors must demonstrate at least three prior contracts with the Department of Veterans Affairs for Splunk deployments within the last two years.

Evaluation: technical capability and past performance, when combined, are significantly more important than price.

Quotes are due November 6, 2026, 12:00 PM ET. Questions must be submitted by November 3, 2026.

This acquisition is unrestricted & open to all responsible sources.
